messages:
rachael: starting RC-2026.7 origination. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.7.tgz and release-notes draft at docs/release-notes/2026.7.md. Planning a short DB migration (online) - migration script included in artifacts. Requesting pin and pre-deploy checklist run.

deploy-bot: build rc-2026.7 (b-1142) uploaded :package:
artifact: s3://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.7.tgz
sha256: f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221100

tom: grabbing artifact to staging now. will run `cictl verify` and a dry-run of the migration in a sandbox cluster.

mike: quick FYI - migration touches embeddings.store schema (adds index) and has a small backfill step. I'd like a maintenance window note in the release notes just in case. @product-erin for ack.

product-erin: product ack for release notes mention. prefer soft notice to customers: "no expected downtime" but may see elevated write latencies for up to 5 mins during backfill.

dbadmin: running migration dry-run on sandbox. observed that backfill can lock hot table if concurrency > 4. Recommend concurrency=2 and use background index build where supported.

rachael: thanks. plan update: pin -> staging deploy -> migration dry-run with concurrency=2 -> smoke -> canary 2% (no routing to legacy instances) -> ramp. Also adding safety hook: automated abort if migration backfill time > 10m or if write latencies > +200ms p95.

deploy-bot: pin request created by rachael -> pin-id: pin-rc-6524. Awaiting promote.

tom: artifact verify passed. dry-run migration completed in sandbox with concurrency=2. no locks observed there.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started. migration dry-run for staging queued.

[staging migration dry-run output]
```
2026-03-21T20:10:02Z - starting backfill pass 1/3 (concurrency=2)
2026-03-21T20:12:55Z - pass 1 complete, delta rows processed: 12k
2026-03-21T20:18:03Z - pass 3 complete, estimated full backfill time 7m
```

qa (mike): staging smoke started after warm. 18/18 checks passed. p95 write latency +40ms, reads unchanged.

rachael: approving canary. oncall-sheriff will you monitor the first 5m of backfill? abort conditions are: backfill >10m OR write p95 > +200ms OR any 5xx surge >0.8%.

oncall-sheriff: standing by. I want telemetry hooks: log the migration progress and emit a metric `migration.progress` every minute. If we lose progress updates for >90s treat as stall and abort.

rachael: promoting to canary now (includes migration) with conservative plan:
```
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6524 --canary 2% --canary-duration 15m --migration concurrency=2 --tag rc-2026.7
```

deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary services provisioned (5 hosts). migration job started on canary shard group.

[3m into canary]

dbadmin: migration progress: pass 1/3 complete on 4/5 shards. `migration.progress` metric reporting: 33%, 35%, 32%, 30% across shards.

mike: telemetry shows p95 write latency spike to +180ms on two canary hosts, still under abort threshold. no 5xx increase.

[7m into canary]

dbadmin: stalled progress on shard-3. last metric at T+4m, then no `migration.progress` updates. trying to fetch live logs.

tom: logs from shard-3 show repeated DB retries: `pq: could not serialize access due to concurrent update` followed by exponential backoff and queueing in worker.

oncall-sheriff: escalating to abort if progress not resumed in next 2m. preparing abort path.

[9m into canary]

rachael: getting reports that backfill on shard-3 is hung and worker pool has queued >3000 backfill tasks, write p95 jumped to +450ms on shard-3. I'm issuing abort now.

/oncall-sheriff: abort initiated

deploy-bot: abort executed by oncall-sheriff. rollback started to stable-2026.6. Migration stopped; partial backfill rolled back where safe.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic restored to stable-2026.6. canary aborted. Incident INC-2026-102 opened: migration stall during canary -> write latency spike.

rachael: immediate actions: mark RC blocked, attach migration logs to incident, schedule postmortem with infra and dbadmin. do not requeue RC until backfill strategy revised (consider chunking by key-range and checkpointing). tagging @dbadmin @eng-runtime @infra-team.

dbadmin: note for postmortem - need to add optimistic concurrency handling and tune transaction isolation for backfill; also add per-shard rate limiter.

product-erin: updating release board and customer comms: setting RC to blocked and updating release notes with "postponed" flag.

oncall-sheriff: closing thread. follow incident INC-2026-102 for updates and do not re-attempt promote without a tested migration plan and a dry-run in scale staging.
